questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg har rejst i Irland før og synes godt om kulturen. Tænkte også det ville være lettere at få venner når alle kan engelsk

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Super nemt, UCC er gode til at give udførlig information selvom det ikke altid er i så god tid

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der bliver holdt et informationsmøde og rundvisning for alle og der bliver sendt en guide ud på forhånd

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Yugo har gode steder, jeg boede på Bottleworks der var så fint men Lee point ligger bedre

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er dyrt alle steder så det må man acceptere, der er virkeligt boligkrise. Busserne er meget billige med upålidelige så lad være med at bo for langt væk. Få et Leepcard til at rejse billigt. Jeg ville sige at Bottleworks så langt ude man kan bo og stadig få det til at fungere

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Meget skulle udfyldes men de er søde til at svare ved spørgsmål og det var en udførlig guide

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: De svarer hurtigt på deres kontor

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alt det jeg ville have, men man skal selv være opmærksom på at timerne ikke overlapper. Stedprøver skrives i hånden så det undgik jeg

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: vær grundig da der er mange steps

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: Det er lavere niveau end KU men alle var meget engagerede i undervisningen

questions.answer: Det var på samme måde som seminar undervisning men uden så mange fremlæggelser

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
Business and human rights
Advanced mediation 
Foundations of international Children's rights 
Intellectual Property

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Advanced mediation var virkeligt nice, Henrietta er en god underviser og hun har de mest spændene gæster med. Der er en meget praktisk tilgang og eksamen er super chill. Man behøver ikke have haft konfliktløsning før

questions.answer: Jeg tog på mange flere ture end jeg regnede med, så hostle i Dublin af flere omgange og Galway samt Belfast

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Maden er billigere og det er ret billigt at gå på cafe sammenlignet med københavn. Det er få steder i byen man betaler for indgang og der er ikke gardarobe de fleste steder

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er virkeligt mange clubs og societies så alt kan man lave i en forening. Der er gratis fitness for alle studerende i et kæmpe center

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Vandreture, den irske natur er så smuk

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag på tur rundt langs kysten og i andre småbyer. Det er ret nemt at komme omkring med bus og ikke så dyrt. Komoot er en god app til at finde vandre ruter

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Så nemt, det er en lille hyggelig by så man bliver hjemmevant hurtigt

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Der er mange foreninger og clubber så meld dig ind hurtigt

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De smalltalker ekstremt meget alle steder hele tiden

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Live musik og pubkulturen er så skøn

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Der er en swap shop på det internationale kontor så vent med at købe ting
- tjek alle de instagramsider der er for de lokale studerende
- Tag til events i starten der bliver holdt for internationale studerende i cork, det er stedet at finde venner hurtigt

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tag på turer der bliver organiseret i starten det er de fleste finder venner og meld dig ind i den store whatsapp gruppe der bliver lavet for internationale studerende i cork. Det er meget lettere at blive venner med andre erasmus end lokale

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Klart de mennesker jeg blev venner med, det hjalp meget at bo på kollgie

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Man skal være meget på i starten og bruge meget energi på nye mennesker, men virkeligt det værd

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
